title: Portfolio home and case study
brief: Dither Layer portfolio for diegnghtmr with the Gentleman Kanagawa palette (dark-first, derived light): three home directions and one multi-repo case study

artboards.title: Split hero with Statement sphere

artboards.title: Engineered work index
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest for tech leads: every project, filters and repo maps in one view; less emotional pull and a quieter brand moment

artboards.title: Portrait and chapters
artboards.tradeoff: Most memorable and personal: dithered portrait plus one chapter per system; slower scan and depends on a clean portrait

artboards.title: Case study: Food Court
artboards.tradeoff: Shows the multi-repo map, panel and list view that any home direction links to; narrative stays draft until M1 confirms it
